# React Barcode Scanner

> React Barcode Scanner is a TypeScript React component and hooks library for scanning QR codes and one-dimensional barcodes in web browsers. It uses the Barcode Detection API with a zbar WebAssembly polyfill, supports isolated multi-scanner state, and provides both ESM and CommonJS package entries.

Use the English documentation as the canonical technical reference. Chinese translations are provided for the same topics. Camera access requires a secure browser context and user permission.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/): Capabilities, use cases, limitations and project links.
- [Installation](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/install): pnpm, yarn, npm and Vite setup.
- [Getting Started](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/guide): Basic scanner, formats, delay, torch, multiple scanners and Next.js.
- [State Scope and Multiple Scanners](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/state-scope): Provider ownership, global compatibility state, lifecycle, async torch behavior and SSR.
- [API Reference](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/api): Components, hooks, options, callbacks, defaults and types.
- [Interactive Demo](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/demo): Browser camera demo and controls.
- [Multiple Scanners Demo](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/multiple-scanners): Test two isolated Provider scopes, streams, controls, errors and lifecycle behavior.
- [FAQ and Troubleshooting](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/docs/faq): Direct answers for compatibility, SSR, permissions and common errors.
- [Full LLM Context](https://reactbarcodescanner.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Condensed package reference and examples.
